workflows.content:
name: Ruby Gem

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master
  push:
    branches:
      - master

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build + Publish
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v2
    - name: Set up Ruby 2.6
      uses: actions/setup-ruby@v1
      with:
        version: 2.6.x

    - name: Publish to GPR
      run: |
        mkdir -p $HOME/.gem
        touch $HOME/.gem/credentials
        chmod 0600 $HOME/.gem/credentials
        printf -- "---\n:github: Bearer ${GEM_HOST_API_KEY}\n" > $HOME/.gem/credentials
        gem build *.gemspec
        gem push --KEY github --host https://rubygems.pkg.github.com/${OWNER} *.gem
      env:
        GEM_HOST_API_KEY: ${{secrets.GPR_AUTH_TOKEN}}
        OWNER: username

    - name: Publish to RubyGems
      run: |
        mkdir -p $HOME/.gem
        touch $HOME/.gem/credentials
        chmod 0600 $HOME/.gem/credentials
        printf -- "---\n:rubygems_api_key: ${GEM_HOST_API_KEY}\n" > $HOME/.gem/credentials
        gem build *.gemspec
        gem push *.gem
      env:
        GEM_HOST_API_KEY: ${{secrets.RUBYGEMS_AUTH_TOKEN}}

workflows.content:
name: CI

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  test:
    name: Test (${{ matrix.os }}, Python ${{ matrix.python-version }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os:
          - ubuntu-latest
          - macos-latest
        python-version:
          - "3.9"
          - "3.12"
          - "3.14"

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Upgrade pip
        run: python -m pip install --upgrade pip

      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
          python -m pip install -e ".[dev]"

      - name: Compile mdns-advertiser
        run: cc -Wall -Wextra -Werror -o /tmp/mdns-advertiser-test build/mdns-advertiser.c

      - name: Compile nbns-advertiser
        run: cc -Wall -Wextra -Werror -o /tmp/nbns-advertiser-test build/nbns-advertiser.c

      - name: Run Ruff
        run: python -m ruff check src tests macos/TimeCapsuleSMB/tools tcapsule

      - name: Verify checked-in artifact manifest
        run: python -m pytest tests/test_artifacts.py tests/test_artifact_resolver.py

      - name: Run full test suite
        run: python -m pytest

  swift-test:
    name: Swift Tests (macOS)
    runs-on: macos-latest

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Show tool versions
        run: |
          xcodebuild -version
          swift --version

      - name: Run Swift tests
        run: swift test --package-path macos/TimeCapsuleSMB

  package-app:
    name: Package App (macOS native)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs:
      - swift-test
    env:
      HOMEBREW_NO_INSTALL_CLEANUP: "1"

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Restore package cache
        uses: actions/cache@v6
        with:
          path: macos/TimeCapsuleSMB/.build/package-app
          key: package-app-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('macos/TimeCapsuleSMB/tools/package_app.py', 'macos/TimeCapsuleSMB/Package.swift', 'macos/TimeCapsuleSMB/Assets/AppIcon/tcs.jpg', 'pyproject.toml', 'requirements.txt', 'src/**', 'bin/**') }}
          restore-keys: |
            package-app-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      - name: Install native packaging tools
        run: |
          brew install samba
          brew tap hudochenkov/sshpass
          brew install sshpass

          smbclient="$(brew --prefix samba)/bin/smbclient"
          sshpass="$(brew --prefix sshpass)/bin/sshpass"

          test -x "$smbclient"
          test -x "$sshpass"
          file "$smbclient" "$sshpass"
          lipo -archs "$smbclient"
          lipo -archs "$sshpass"

          {
            echo "TCAPSULE_PACKAGE_SMBCLIENT=$smbclient"
            echo "TCAPSULE_PACKAGE_SSHPASS=$sshpass"
          } >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Package and validate native app
        run: |
          python3 macos/TimeCapsuleSMB/tools/package_app.py \
            --configuration release \
            --arch native \
            --full-validation

name: CodeQL

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  schedule:
    - cron: "36 5 * * 1"

permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: read
  security-events: write

jobs:
  analyze:
    name: Analyze (${{ matrix.language }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        language:
          - python

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Initialize CodeQL
        uses: github/codeql-action/init@v4
        with:
          languages: ${{ matrix.language }}

      - name: Perform CodeQL analysis
        uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v4
        with:
          category: "/language:${{ matrix.language }}"

workflows.content:
name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    # Mondays 06:00 UTC: run the SDK integration tests against the latest
    # Microsoft.Graph.Authentication to catch SDK behavior changes early.
    - cron: '0 6 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .tools
          key: tools-lint-${{ hashFiles('build.ps1') }}

      - name: PSScriptAnalyzer and manifests
        shell: pwsh
        run: ./build.ps1 -Task Lint

  test:
    name: Test (${{ matrix.name }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - { name: 'Linux, PowerShell 7', os: ubuntu-latest, shell: pwsh }
          - { name: 'macOS, PowerShell 7', os: macos-latest, shell: pwsh }
          - { name: 'Windows, PowerShell 7', os: windows-latest, shell: pwsh }
          - { name: 'Windows PowerShell 5.1', os: windows-latest, shell: powershell }
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: ${{ matrix.shell }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .tools
          key: tools-test-${{ runner.os }}-${{ matrix.shell }}-${{ hashFiles('build.ps1') }}

      - name: Pester unit tests
        run: ./build.ps1 -Task Test

      - name: Upload test results
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: test-results-${{ runner.os }}-${{ matrix.shell }}
          path: TestResults/
          if-no-files-found: ignore

  integration:
    # macOS lets an unprivileged process bind port 80, which the SDK tests'
    # stub Graph endpoint needs. See Modules/keel.Mail/Tests/keel.Mail.Sdk.Tests.ps1.
    name: Integration (Graph SDK ${{ matrix.sdk }})
    runs-on: macos-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        # Pinned on every run; latest only on the weekly schedule or when started by hand.
        sdk: ${{ fromJSON((github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') && '["pinned", "latest"]' || '["pinned"]') }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        if: ${{ matrix.sdk == 'pinned' }}
        with:
          path: .tools
          key: tools-integration-${{ hashFiles('build.ps1') }}

      - name: Pester integration tests
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          SDK_CHANNEL: ${{ matrix.sdk }}
        run: |
          if ($env:SDK_CHANNEL -eq 'latest') {
              ./build.ps1 -Task Integration -GraphSdkVersion Latest
          }
          else {
              ./build.ps1 -Task Integration
          }

      - name: Upload test results
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: integration-results-${{ matrix.sdk }}
          path: TestResults/
          if-no-files-found: ignore

version: 2
updates:
  # Keeps the SHA-pinned actions in .github/workflows current.
  # PowerShell Gallery tools are pinned in build.ps1 and updated by hand.
  - package-ecosystem: github-actions
    directory: /
    schedule:
      interval: weekly
    groups:
      actions:
        patterns: ['*']

workflows.content:
name: Check security.txt

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "17 13 * * 1" # Mondays, 13:17 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - ".well-known/security.txt"
      - ".github/workflows/check-security-txt.yml"
      - ".github/scripts/check-security-txt.sh"

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: write # Re-enable this workflow's schedule (inactivity keepalive)

concurrency:
  group: security-txt
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      # On a pull request, check the proposed file before it ships.
      - name: Check proposed security.txt
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: bash .github/scripts/check-security-txt.sh .well-known/security.txt 60

      # Otherwise check what visitors and scanners actually receive.
      - name: Check live security.txt
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        run: bash .github/scripts/check-security-txt.sh https://jacksonasmith.com/.well-known/security.txt 60

      - name: Keep scheduled workflow enabled
        if: always() && github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          # GitHub disables cron schedules after 60 days without repository
          # activity, and scheduled runs don't count as activity.
          # Re-enabling on every run resets that timer.
          gh api -X PUT "repos/${{ github.repository }}/actions/workflows/check-security-txt.yml/enable"

  - package-ecosystem: github-actions

    schedule:

    groups:
      actions:
        patterns: ['*']
